# Daily Briefing – Wednesday 8 July

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training, just 2,723 steps and 1,630 kcal burned. That's a significant calorie deficit day, which is great for your 80-85kg target, but make sure you still hit those 175g of protein even on rest days to protect muscle mass.

The recovery numbers are genuinely excellent. HRV at 113ms sits comfortably within your 102-120ms baseline, resting HR is a very healthy 46 bpm, and stress at 25/100 is minimal. Your body is well-rested and primed — no reason to hold back today. Go as planned and trust that readiness.

One tip: with only 1,630 kcal burned yesterday, you may feel hungrier today as you train. Front-load your protein early — aim for 50g before midday — so you're not scrambling to hit 175g late in the evening. You've got this! 💪
